title: eluLayer
summary: Create an ELU layer compatibility object.
description: `eluLayer` creates metadata for ELU activation layers.
behaviors: A leading numeric scalar sets `Alpha`; the default alpha is `1`.
`Name`, `Description`, and other common options are stored as properties.

example.input:
layer = eluLayer
layer = eluLayer(alpha)
layer = eluLayer(___, Name, Value)

gpu_residency: Layer construction is host metadata work and has no provider kernel.
